nodes.label: MILD combustion of NH3/H2 to reduce NOx (Cantera PSR)
nodes.rationale: MILD regime features (low temperature rise, sustained reaction at low O2) could benefit ammonia combustion and lower NOx despite hydrogen enrichment.
